## 3D Omni Prompt System

### Shared Continuity Header
> **Global Style Directive:** Apply to every block: cinematic premium 3D motion design for an enterprise autonomous AI workforce; physically based rendering; dark navy spatial environment `#0B1B3D`; signal-red energy and action states `#D42429`; soft-white interfaces and typography `#F5F5F5`; brushed graphite, smoked glass, satin ceramic and subtle emissive materials; controlled volumetric lighting; crisp reflections; high contrast; elegant depth; realistic global illumination; 24 fps; 180-degree shutter; smooth intentional camera movement; precise beat-synced animation at 120 BPM; centered composition with 9:16-safe hero action; no supplied logo, so use clean text-only Motahai end card.

### OMNI-01 — Pressure / Fragmented Work
- **Prompt:** Wide macro-to-orbit shot inside a vast navy operational space. Dozens of soft-white task tiles, message fragments, timelines and process tokens float in disconnected lanes. Thin red warning filaments reveal friction, duplicated handoffs and stalled queues without showing error text. Begin on an extreme close-up of one task tile at 00:00, rapidly dolly backward to reveal the fragmented system by 00:04, then orbit as layers stack into a visual bottleneck. At 00:08, all ambient motion suspends for one beat; a single clean red signal slices left-to-right and pulls every particle toward the next scene. Premium enterprise scale, disciplined geometry, no chaos for chaos’s sake. On-screen copy appears in soft white: “WORK MOVES FAST.”
- **Camera:** 50mm macro opening → 28mm wide reveal; subtle 10-degree clockwise orbit.
- **Motion Beats:** tile ignition on bar 1; queue expansion bars 2–3; bottleneck bar 4; signal wipe bar 5.
- **Negative Prompt:** humanoid robots, literal office workers, cyberpunk city, green code rain, neon rainbow, cheap holograms, excessive lens flare, illegible UI, floating gibberish, stock dashboard aesthetic, red-dominant frame.

### OMNI-02 — Motahai Reveal / Objective to Plan
- **Prompt:** Continue the red signal into a monumental dark-navy chamber where it enters a suspended satin-ceramic intelligence core. The core is abstract and architectural, not a brain or robot. A soft-white objective card docks at its center. Concentric red planning rings calculate outward, then six specialized agent nodes unfold with mechanically precise, elegant motion. Show the objective decomposing into ordered work packets and routing paths. Camera performs a confident push through the planning rings, ending with agent nodes launching into depth at 00:18. During the silent final bar, one node passes close to camera as a seamless object wipe. On-screen copy transitions from “ONE OBJECTIVE.” to “AUTONOMOUS EXECUTION.”
- **Camera:** 35mm symmetrical hero frame → 24mm forward push.
- **Motion Beats:** objective dock bar 6; planning rings bars 7–8; agent deployment bar 9; node wipe bar 10.
- **Negative Prompt:** human faces, robot heads, glowing brain, sci-fi spaceship, magic particles, blue-only palette, uncontrolled bloom, cluttered labels, brand logos not provided.

### OMNI-03 — Orchestration / Intelligent Handoffs
- **Prompt:** Reveal a multi-level autonomous workflow lattice suspended in a navy void. Six distinct abstract agent modules—research lens, operations cube, communication prism, analysis sphere, quality gate and coordinator ring—move work packets through a clear network. Red pulses represent active decisions; soft-white trails represent verified context. Each module receives, checks, transforms and hands off one packet with no collisions. Use a continuous tracking shot traveling alongside the packet, with brief rack-focus moments showing collaboration and contextual checks. At 00:28 all modules synchronize; one red pulse traverses the full lattice during the silent bar and carries the camera through a portal into block four. On-screen copy: “COORDINATED BY DESIGN.”
- **Camera:** 40mm lateral tracking, shallow-to-deep focus progression, smooth portal finish.
- **Motion Beats:** receive bar 11; context check bar 12; transform bar 13; handoff bar 14; synchronized pulse bar 15.
- **Negative Prompt:** conveyor-belt factory cliché, robot arms, chaotic traffic, microscopic unreadable labels, gaming HUD, flicker, jitter, random camera shake, multicolor nodes.

### OMNI-04 — Cross-Functional Execution
- **Prompt:** Camera emerges into one expansive 3D operations plane divided into four elegant lanes: Research, Operations, Marketing and Analytics. Represent each function through abstract but immediately legible objects: a scanning lens over structured knowledge, a precision workflow engine, a campaign signal array, and a dimensional performance graph. A single work packet travels through all four lanes while each module generates a tangible completed asset. Red activation light advances lane by lane; soft-white verified outputs stack cleanly behind it. By 00:38 the four outputs converge into one polished execution cube, which closes perfectly during the silent fifth bar. Minimal soft-white labels appear one at a time: “RESEARCH,” “OPERATIONS,” “MARKETING,” “ANALYTICS.”
- **Camera:** 28mm diagonal glide with parallax; finish on centered 50mm product shot.
- **Motion Beats:** research bar 16; operations bar 17; marketing bar 18; analytics bar 19; convergence bar 20.
- **Negative Prompt:** literal social platform logos, fake metrics, unreadable charts, generic office footage, consumer-tech gloss, playful cartoon shapes, rainbow gradients, exaggerated speed blur.

### OMNI-05 — Governance / Human Command
- **Prompt:** The execution cube opens into a refined command environment. Place a single human decision silhouette only as an understated scale reference, seen from behind and never as a character performance. In front, a clean soft-white approval ring, decision lineage, audit trail and outcome markers assemble around the autonomous system. Show agents continuing to work in the background while one red exception path rises for approval, pauses, receives a precise soft-white confirmation, and rejoins the workflow. Visualize governance as clarity, not surveillance. At 00:48, the approval ring closes and all decision paths become a stable horizon line during the dialogue-free bar. On-screen copy: “CONTROL WITHOUT BOTTLENECKS.”
- **Camera:** 45mm over-shoulder architectural composition; slow 8% push-in.
- **Motion Beats:** visibility bar 21; audit trail bar 22; exception bar 23; approval bar 24; horizon resolve bar 25.
- **Negative Prompt:** biometric scanning, dystopian surveillance, executive stock-photo pose, hand touching hologram, dense compliance text, police red lights, fear-based visuals, facial close-up.

### OMNI-06 — Transformation / End Card
- **Prompt:** Begin with the stable horizon line from block five. Camera rises to reveal the formerly fragmented tasks now flowing as one elegant, self-running operating system: clear lanes, coordinated agent nodes and completed outputs expanding into the distance. The network scales upward and outward while preserving order. A red energy line accelerates ahead of the camera, forming a precise forward arrow through the system without using a literal icon. At 00:56, architecture compresses into a dark navy hero plane; soft-white headline “MULTIPLY YOUR CAPACITY.” appears with restrained red accent. At 00:58, resolve to a centered text-only “MOTAHAI” wordmark and small descriptor “AUTONOMOUS AI WORKFORCE.” Hold for two seconds with subtle living light and no additional motion except a final red pulse at 00:59.
- **Camera:** 24mm ascending crane and forward glide → locked 70mm end-card frame.
- **Motion Beats:** system reveal bar 26; ordered scale bars 27–28; headline bar 29; end-card hold bar 30.
- **Negative Prompt:** unsupported logo design, website URL, fake CTA button, explosive finale, confetti, lens-flare washout, tiny legal copy, rapid end-card motion, visual clutter.

Pull back slightly at 00:40 so governance and voiceover remain clear, using a steady bass pulse and transparent high texture. Build decisively from 00:50 with fuller strings, broad synth bed and controlled cinematic percussion, resolving into one premium impact at 00:59 with a one-second polished tail. Create a micro-transition every ten seconds and a clear musical breath from second 8 to 10 of each block. Keep the dialogue band open around 1–4 kHz; instrumental only; mix-ready stems for pulse, percussion, bass, harmony, texture and impacts.

```text
Structure tags: [Instrumental] [120 BPM] [4/4] [Minimal Intro] [Building Energy] [Hybrid Orchestral Electronic] [Dialogue-Safe] [Controlled Climax] [Logo Sting] [Clean End]

Exclude: vocals, choir, spoken words, trailer braams, aggressive EDM drop, festival synths, trap hi-hats, dubstep bass, horror tension, playful corporate ukulele, funk guitar, retro arcade sounds, excessive risers, constant impacts, over-compression.

Mix targets: voiceover remains dominant; music ducks approximately 2–3 dB under speech; transition bars may lift approximately 1.5 dB; final impact short and controlled; no reverb tail beyond 01:00.
```

## Assembly Rules

1. **Grid Cut Constraint:** Cut only on the 120 BPM grid; major scene changes land exactly every 5 bars (10.000s).
2. **Buffer Protection:** Protect the final 2 seconds of every block (the 5th bar) from dialogue, new claims, and dense copy.
3. **Color Balance:** Keep `#D42429` (Signal Red) strictly as an active status/energy accent; `#0B1B3D` (Deep Navy) dominates the frame (>= 65% area).
4. **Typography:** Maximum one principal text statement per shot; soft-white `#F5F5F5` within title safe zone.
5. **Node Identity:** Preserve identical agent 3D geometry across blocks 02–06 to maintain strict character and visual consistency.
6. **Continuous Momentum:** Maintain a continuous left-to-right or forward visual momentum; never reverse spatial direction.
7. **Aspect Ratio Safe Zone:** Master in 16:9 with all hero actions and text centered within the 56.25% center box for seamless 9:16 vertical crop.
8. **End Card:** Final brand lockup runs from 00:58 to 01:00 with clean tail, no reverb spill beyond 01:00.
